shortDescription: Australian toll road operator Transurban ASX:TCL said on Thursday it will acquire Canada Pension Plan Investment Board's  interests in NorthWestern Roads Group and Sydney Transport Partners for A$4.5 billion ($3.13 billion).Here are some more details:($1 = 1.4397 Australian dollars)

children: said on Thursday it will acquire Canada Pension Plan Investment Board's  interests in NorthWestern Roads Group and Sydney Transport Partners for A$4.5 billion ($3.13 billion).
Upon completion, Transurban's ownership interest in NorthWestern Roads Group (NRG) will rise to 75% from 50%, while its interest in Sydney Transport Partners (STP) will increase to 60.5% from 50%.
NorthWestern Roads Group owns Westlink M7 and NorthConnex motorway networks, while Sydney Transport Partners owns WestConnex network.
Transurban said there will be no change to tolls for New South Wales motorists and no substantive impact on NRG and STP's governance rights.
It expects the acquisition to be completed in 2027.
